title.narrative: Completion grant for sustainable transfer of knowledge from UNEP DTU Partnerskab to UNEP CCC

description.narrative:
Original objective of the programme: The overall objective of the core programme, is to contribute to obtaining the climate change outcome targets 1a and 1b of UN Environment's Medium Term Strategy (MTS) 2018-2021 and the underlying Biannual Programme of Work (PoW). This is in alignment with the combined Danish and UN Environment priorities related to SDG 7 - access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all - and SDG 13 - urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts. The core programme's outcomes thus feed into the overall UNEP DTU Partnership (UDP) strategic framework and are implemented in synergy with other ongoing activities
Objective for additional and closing grant. Sustainable transfer of 30 years of knowledge from UNEP DTU Partnerskab (former Risø) to UNEP Copenhagen Climate Center by securing transfer of most possible staff and covering costs for staff beyond the no-cost extension that cannot not being transferred to the new center.
The grant is cover costs for UNEP-DTU staff that cannot be transferred to the new UNEP-CCC.
